logic.entry: predicted normalized PNL times decision-known NAV > buffer; base forecast reused across stressed scenarios
logic.exit: fixed24h next minute; repeat after next hourly signal; terminal exit cost included
logic.sizing: floor .25*known total NAV/known spot to common lot; each leg25%, gross50%, two isolated books/no transfers
logic.features: original F01..F12; train non-null coverage >=98%; median imputer and StandardScaler fit only training; unavailable OI/indicative funding/takerflow/L2/cross factors stay null
logic.training: decision in train range AND label_end_ts AND label_available_ts strictly before train_end; each fit has embargo 3 days before test start
logic.labels: same matched 24h next-minute execution/cost/funding rules as extension at nominal NAV10000, target per-leg .25; maturity max(exit, funding available). Costs base1x. Endogenous future cost is label, never feature. Purge overlapping immature labels.
logic.execution: signal hourly completed close at T, actual next T+1 minute open; quantities known before gap funding, gap settles old position before fill; fixed T+24h expiry executed next minute; continuous holdings across folds; terminal liquidation costs

costs.paid_funding: actual negative receipts multiplied; positive receipts unchanged
costs.metadata: frozen actual prior-round exchange snapshot assumed for history
